channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about AJ Dybantsa | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about AJ Dybantsa from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Will Dawkins on AJ Dybantsa
item.description:
Will Dawkins:

“We have guys who bring sleeping bags to the gym, and he (AJ Dybantsa) is one of those guys.”

Will Dawkins on AJ Dybantsa, Sep 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Ryan Smith on AJ Dybantsa, Darryn Peterson
item.description:
Ryan Smith:

“I feel like we feel really good about where we're at with Darryn (Peterson), and things happen for a reason. But love AJ (Dybantsa), heck of a player. But, you know, we've been watching Darryn and AJ and we really like what Darren's, what Darren's got.”

Ryan Smith on AJ Dybantsa, Darryn Peterson, Sep 23, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Trae Young on AJ Dybantsa
item.description:
Trae Young on what he was thinking when he watched AJ Dybantsa and the young Wizards summer league team last night:

“I’m ready to play tomorrow after seeing them play last night. When you see what they did last night gives you more excitement.”

Trae Young on AJ Dybantsa, Jul 10, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Darryn Peterson on AJ Dybantsa
item.description:
“I was a little bit surprised how the consensus has shifted. Now I know Darryn Peterson didn't have the season he wanted. But I've seen those guys on the same floor in person probably 8-10 times…Not once did I come away thinking AJ Dybantsa is a better prospect than Darryn Peterson.”

Darryn Peterson on AJ Dybantsa, May 12, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Jalen Williams on AJ Dybantsa
item.description:
Jalen Williams on his relationship with AJ Dybantsa:

“I know Thunder Twitter and everybody else in the world is going to run with what I say, so I gotta be careful. Just a good dude… Everybody knows about the picks and everything going on.”

Jalen Williams on AJ Dybantsa, Dec 17, 2025. Source: x.com.
